name: MulDimIF
intro: MulDimIF 用三种约束形式、四类约束与四级难度细分指令遵循能力。它从 ShareGPT 抽取原始指令，经 GPT-4o 约束扩展、冲突检测和形式重写，再由六名标注员交叉复核数据与验证代码，发布 7,906 条训练指令和 1,200 条测试指令。
org: Fudan University, Lenovo Research, Tencent, Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: 自动生成, 人工标注, 代码验证, 混合
task_type: 指令遵循, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 三种约束形式, 四类约束, 四级难度, 双人交叉验证, GRPO
scale: 7,906 条训练指令, 1,200 条测试指令
build_method_en: Automated Generation, Human Annotation, Code Verification, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Three Constraint Patterns, Four Categories, Four Difficulty Levels, Dual Human Validation, GRPO
intro_en: MulDimIF decomposes instruction following across three constraint patterns, four categories, and four difficulty levels. It samples raw ShareGPT instructions, applies GPT-4o constraint expansion, conflict detection, and pattern rewriting, then has six annotators cross-review the data and validation code before releasing 7,906 training and 1,200 test instructions.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.07591 Section 3, Section 5, and Appendices B, E, and F plus the official MulDimIF repository. The diagrams preserve ShareGPT sampling, the 3-pattern/4-category/13-subcategory/4-level framework, GPT-4o expansion by one or two constraints, dual conflict checks and discard rule, three-example rewriting, six annotators over four weeks with at least two reviewers per item, DeepSeek-V3 validator drafts and dual code approval, exact 7,906/1,200 split, 18-model greedy evaluation, code-based constraint checks, and six-model GRPO improvement.
